title: Confirm a sender address
askBy: {{name}} (administrator of {{org}}) asks to use {{email}} to send automated emails from Cellhive of {{org}}.
ask: {{org}} asks to use {{email}} to send automated emails from its Cellhive.
ignore: Did not ask for this? Close this page. The address is not used unless someone presses Confirm.
done: {{email}} can now send automated emails of {{org}}. You can close this page.
doneShort: {{email}} can now send automated emails. You can close this page.
invalid: It is wrong, already used, replaced by a newer email or expired (links are valid for 24 hours). Ask the organization administrator to send a new verification email if needed.
expired: Ask the organization administrator to send the verification email again. Links are valid for 24 hours.
rateLimited: Too many requests from your network. Try again in a few minutes.
